projects.title: Noir Scents
projects.summary: A full-stack perfume storefront for browsing products, maintaining inventory, creating orders, and completing online payment. Its React storefront communicates with a FastAPI service backed by PostgreSQL.
projects.purpose: Bring product discovery, stock control, customer checkout, and order administration into one e-commerce application.
projects.role: Independently developed and maintained in the owner?s public GitHub repository.
projects.status: Live frontend and backend health checks respond.
implemented: Product catalogue and inventory management; order creation and management through the API.
Paystack payment initialization and server-side transaction verification. Creating an order reserves stock; failed or abandoned Paystack payments restore the reserved stock.
Google sign-in backed by server-side identity-token verification and a seven-day application session.
Mailgun welcome messages and order confirmations after verified payment; delivery depends on valid server-side Mailgun configuration.
notes: Customer account, checkout, Paystack transaction, stock restoration, and email flows were not end-to-end tested in the deployed environment.
Paystack is the only online provider documented as implemented. Flutterwave and OPay are pending integrations; bank transfer is pending/manual. Do not present them as operational payment methods.
projects.problem: A single storefront and service are needed to connect product browsing, stock tracking, customer orders, and online payment.

projects.title: Ziki Redesign
projects.summary: A browser-based collaboration workspace that helps contributors explore issue opportunities, shape reviewable plans, and keep approval decisions with a person. The seven-agent crew and workflow are local simulations rather than connected AI or repository services.
projects.purpose: Demonstrate a human-controlled multi-agent work process with explicit planning, permissions, review, revision, and approval stages.
projects.role: Built the frontend prototype and its local workflow simulation in the public repository under Godscovenant Udofe?s account.
projects.ownership: Independent frontend prototype ? personal public repository
projects.status: Live interactive frontend prototype ? local simulations.
implemented: Seven specialist robot personas, task creation and queues, agent conversations, and local draft preparation.
Illustrative issue recommendations, plan details, scope, assumptions, risks, dependencies, time estimates, and requested permissions.
Human review actions: approve a displayed plan, reject it, or request a revision; simulated work status and activity history persist in browser localStorage.
Responsive workspace navigation and reduced-motion handling.
notes: Issue examples and agent responses are local demo fixtures/templates. The deployment does not document a specific prior interface problem addressed by the redesign.
This project is separate from the owner?s Ziki PR #624, which adds automated end-to-end tests to the existing Ziki product.
projects.problem: Demonstrates how a contributor workspace could organize opportunities, plans, permissions, and human review. The source does not document a specific prior interface problem.
